messages:
lina (Marketing): Draft is live in Drive — angle: hands-on launch playbook focused on inference cost + routing. link: https://docs.example/launch-playbook-new
omar (Growth): nice. two quick asks: gate a short playbook asset for MQL capture, and standardize UTMs/lead tag for routing.
felix (Product): adding bench numbers now (p50/p95/p99) and a short cost calc. will mark as internal.
tara (Content): i'll trim the intro to ~60 words and add a boxed quickstart code snippet. also proposing a one-paragraph FAQ for buyer signals.
jamie (Sales): Sales wants a HubSpot routing map and a single lead tag so SDRs can filter; also need a one-slide "qualification" checklist.
omar (Growth): suggested UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=playbook. lead property: launch_source=optimize_blog
felix (Product): bench numbers added to doc: p50=32ms, p95=110ms, p99=185ms; cost ~ $0.00185 per 1k tokens on recommended config. marked "internal benchmark (typical workload)".
lina (Marketing): i'll attribute as internal. webhook-bot created provisional webinar 2026-05-15T16:00Z (https://cal.example/w/zz123).
jamie (Sales): webinar week after publish works. sales will co-host partner seats; will need playbook CSV export and slide for objection handling.
tara (Content): post structure proposal: problem (1 line), playbook steps (routing, caching, quant), benchmarks, quickstart snippet, gated playbook CTA -> webinar. ok?
omar (Growth): yes. gating -> when asset downloaded set Lifecycle Stage = marketing qualified and tag launch_source=optimize_blog.
lina (Marketing): devs, sample webhook payload for asset download — confirm fields: 
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "company_domain": "{{company_domain}}",
  "job_title": "{{job_title}}",
  "utm_campaign": "optimize_launch",
  "lead_tag": "optimize_blog",
  "model_profile": "{{model_profile}}",
  "asset_type": "pdf"
}
```
felix (Product): include model_profile and company_domain — good idea for correlating benchmarks.
jamie (Sales): add field is_partner (boolean) so SDRs can prioritize partner leads.
lina (Marketing): adding is_partner and partner utm param when relevant. timeline check: copy-lock Thu, assets Fri, publish Tue. everyone good?
felix (Product): good.
tara (Content): will finalize edits Thu morning.
jamie (Sales): sales ok.
webhook-bot: reminder set: copy-lock review in #marketing on 2026-04-16T15:00Z.
lina (Marketing): thanks all — i'll post when copy is locked.
